key_provisions_or_claims: Commission published non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the AI Act.
Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system.
Guidelines will evolve and be updated based on practical experience.
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules, including definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025.
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page (Slovenian version) announcing non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, published alongside guidelines on prohibited practices, and listing downloadable guideline files in all EU languages.
annotation.title_clean: Komisija objavila smernice o opredelitvi umetnointeligenčnega sistema, da bi olajšala prvo uporabo pravil iz akta o umetni inteligenci
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate the first AI Act rules' application
